_🧹 Nitpick_ | _🔵 Trivial_

**Good accessibility implementation with live region announcements.**

The announcement state properly informs screen reader users of tag operations. One minor edge case: if a user attempts to add the same duplicate tag consecutively, the announcement text remains unchanged, so some screen readers may not re-announce. A common pattern is to briefly clear the announcement before setting the new message to force re-announcement.

<details>
<summary>💡 Optional enhancement for consistent re-announcement</summary>

```diff
  const addTag = () => {
    const trimmedInput = inputValue.trim();
    if (!trimmedInput) return;

    if (value.includes(trimmedInput)) {
      setInputValue('');
+     setAnnouncement('');
+     setTimeout(() => setAnnouncement(`Tag "${trimmedInput}" is already added`), 50);
-     setAnnouncement(`Tag "${trimmedInput}" is already added`);
      return;
    }
```
</details>




Also applies to: 54-54, 60-62

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
In `@apps/web/src/components/ui/tag-input.tsx` at line 26, The live-region
announcement stored in announcement and updated via setAnnouncement can stutter
when the same message is set twice (e.g., adding the same duplicate tag
consecutively); update the tag add/remove handlers (the functions that call
setAnnouncement when tags are added/removed) to briefly clear the announcement
before setting the new message (e.g., setAnnouncement('') then schedule the
actual message with setTimeout or requestAnimationFrame) so screen readers
reliably re-announce duplicate operations.
```

</details>
